title: Keep Notion projects and Folk contacts in step, with a weekly stale-deal note
systemName: Your Notion to Folk sync and stale-deal digest

facts: Post: real estate investment and development firm; Claude or Google Apps Script automations; Notion project management and Folk CRM kept organized and connected to other tools; Google Workspace.
Felix named as the client contact in three separate reviews (2026-09-21, 2026-07-27, 2026-06-21). Not evidenced as owner.
No Notion or Folk adapter exists; Notion and Folk are named only as data sources in a Claude Code transcript and the custom workspace.

scenes.title: Claude Code writes the sync for you.
scenes.caption: It reads both field lists, writes one Apps Script file, and tests it on sample projects before anything runs for real.
scenes.beat: Here I ask Claude Code to connect Notion and Folk. It reads the project fields and the contact fields, writes the Apps Script, and does a dry run on three sample projects. One project has no matching contact, so it gets held for review instead of creating a duplicate.
details: Dry run only on illustrative data; real field names are confirmed with you first.
